title: PreCoG: Preview-Edit for Efficient Video Correction in Generation-Time
title_zh: PreCoG：生成时高效视频修正的预览-编辑方法

paragraphs.en: Iterative text-to-video generation relies on feedback to correct compositional and temporal failures. However, existing methods typically require another full generation run for each correction, repeating computation and potentially disrupting already correct content. We introduce PreCoG , an iterative framework for correcting semantic failures during video generation. PreQA diagnoses failures from low-cost previews and constructs corrective conditions, while PreEdit edits cached generation trajectories under these conditions, attenuating orthogonal changes to limit disruption of already correct content. PreCoG completes generation only for the selected candidate, reusing its cached trajectory to reduce redundant computation and help preserve semantic consistency between the preview and the final video. Experiments show that PreCoG achieves the highest VBench and T2V-CompBench scores and approaches VSR’s leading VS2 score at 0.56 × 0.56\times its inference time. It also outperforms GENMAC on all three quality and alignment metrics at 0.86 × 0.86\times its inference time.
paragraphs.zh: 迭代式文本到视频生成依赖反馈来纠正构图和时间维度上的问题。 然而，现有方法通常每次修正都需要重新执行一次完整的生成过程，导致重复计算，并可能破坏原本正确的内容。 我们提出了 PreCoG，一个用于在视频生成过程中纠正语义问题的迭代框架。 PreQA 通过低成本预览诊断问题并构建修正条件，而 PreEdit 则在这些条件下编辑缓存的生成轨迹，同时抑制无关变化，以尽量减少对已正确内容的干扰。 PreCoG 仅对选定的候选结果完成生成，并复用其缓存的生成轨迹，以减少冗余计算，并帮助保持预览与最终视频之间的语义一致性。 实验表明，PreCoG 在 VBench 和 T2V-CompBench 测试中获得了最高分数，并在 0.56 × 0.56\times 推理时间的情况下接近 VSR 的领先 VS2 分数。 它在所有三项质量和对齐指标上均优于 GENMAC，且推理时间仅为后者的 0.86 × 0.86\times。

paragraphs.en: Text-to-video generation is rarely a one-shot process in creative workflows. Users often generate, inspect, revise, and regenerate until one candidate satisfies the prompt. This loop is costly for two reasons. First, each full rendering requires expensive denoising steps. Second, even strong models frequently fail on compositional requirements such as subject presence, action binding, spatial relations, physical interactions, and temporal progression, often requiring multiple generation attempts before an acceptable result is obtained. Consequently, substantial computation can be spent on videos that are ultimately rejected.
paragraphs.zh: 在创意工作流程中，文本到视频生成很少是一次就能完成的过程。 用户通常会不断生成、检查、修改和重新生成，直到某个候选结果满足提示要求。 这种循环之所以代价高昂，有两个原因。 首先，每次完整的渲染都需要耗资巨大的去噪步骤。 其次，即使是强大的模型也常常无法满足构图方面的要求，例如主体存在性、动作绑定、空间关系、物理交互和时间推进，通常需要进行多次生成尝试才能获得一个可接受的结果。 因此，大量计算资源可能被消耗在最终被拒绝的视频上。

paragraphs.en: Recent video-feedback methods make this iterative process more systematic by evaluating generated videos and using the resulting critique to guide the next attempt. VQQA ( Song et al., 2026 ) and VISTA ( Long et al., 2025 ) use generated videos as feedback to critique and refine prompts for subsequent generation rounds. However, while each corrected candidate is sampled again under a revised prompt, content that was already satisfactory in the previous video may drift in the next attempt. GENMAC ( Huang et al., 2026 ) further redesigns text prompts, frame-wise layouts, and guidance scales for compositional generation. Despite improving how the next attempt is guided, these methods still realize correction through regeneration. Each correction requires another full synthesis run, repeating computation and potentially disrupting already correct content.

paragraphs.en: These limitations call for a corrective generation process that can intervene early, preserve valid content, and reuse prior computation. Meeting these requirements requires reconsidering when feedback is obtained and how it is applied within the generation process. This leads to three design principles. First, the system should assess low-cost previews before full rendering, since early iterations are primarily diagnostic. Second, feedback should guide corrective edits relative to an existing source trajectory, avoiding generation from scratch. Since the source may only partially align with its condition, correction must address unmet requirements while preserving satisfied ones and limiting unrelated changes. Third, the computation already spent on a source video should be treated as a computational asset, with cached denoising states, source velocities, and solver state supporting subsequent editing and continuation.
paragraphs.zh: 这些局限性要求一种纠正性生成过程，该过程能够早期介入、保留有效内容并复用先前的计算。 要满足这些要求，需要重新思考在何时获取反馈以及如何在生成过程中应用这些反馈。 由此引出了三项设计原则。 首先，系统应在完整渲染前评估低成本预览，因为早期迭代主要用于诊断。 其次，反馈应指导相对于现有源轨迹的纠正性编辑，避免从头开始生成。 由于源内容可能仅部分符合其条件，因此纠正必须解决未满足的要求，同时保留已满足的要求并限制无关更改。 第三，为源视频已经投入的计算应被视为计算资产，缓存的去噪状态、源速度和求解器状态应为后续的编辑和延续提供支持。

paragraphs.en: Building on these principles, we propose PreCoG , a preview-guided corrective generation framework for iterative text-to-video generation. PreCoG consists of two coupled components. PreQA comprises three agents: the Planning Agent constructs the initial design and fixed visual requirements. The Evaluation Agent diagnoses unmet requirements in each preview. The Refinement Agent constructs a matched target–counterfactual condition pair, contrasting the intended scene with observed failures under shared context. PreEdit uses their prediction contrast to steer source-relative updates toward correcting the diagnosed source–condition misalignments. Blockwise soft projection emphasizes this correction direction while attenuating orthogonal updates, aiming to preserve satisfied requirements and limit unrelated changes. It reuses the source trajectory, velocities, and solver state cached during generation rather than reconstructing them from a rendered video. Each correction edits the cached trajectory of the preview with the highest requirement coverage.
paragraphs.zh: 基于这些原则，我们提出了 PreCoG——一种以预览为指导的修正生成框架，用于迭代式文本到视频生成。 PreCoG 由两个相互耦合的组件构成。 PreQA 包含三个智能体：规划智能体负责构建初始设计和固定的视觉要求。 评估智能体负责诊断每次预览中未满足的要求。 优化智能体构建一个匹配的目标-反事实条件对，在共享上下文中对比预期场景与观察到的失败情况。 PreEdit 利用它们的预测差异，引导源相关的更新，以修正诊断出的源与条件之间的不匹配问题。 分块软投影强调这一修正方向，同时减弱正交方向的更新，旨在保留已满足的要求并限制无关的变化。 它重新使用生成过程中缓存的源轨迹、速度和求解器状态，而不是从渲染后的视频中重建它们。 每次修正都会编辑具有最高要求覆盖率的预览的缓存轨迹。

paragraphs.en: Video-feedback correction evaluates generated videos and converts diagnosed failures into guidance for subsequent refinement. NeuS-E ( Choi et al., 2025 ) uses a formal video representation to identify inconsistent events, objects, and frames for targeted editing. VideoRepair ( Lee et al., 2024 ) uses MLLM-generated evaluation questions to detect misalignment, then segments correctly generated entities and selectively regenerates problematic regions. VQQA ( Song et al., 2026 ) dynamically generates visual questions and converts VLM critiques into actionable prompt updates through a black-box language interface. VISTA ( Long et al., 2025 ) likewise uses video-level critiques to refine prompts for subsequent generation rounds. GENMAC ( Huang et al., 2026 ) extends this loop with multi-agent verification and redesign of prompts, layouts, and guidance scales. These approaches differ in whether feedback triggers localized editing or another generation round. PreCoG obtains feedback from low-cost previews and corrects the cached trajectory before full rendering.

sents.zh: VISTA（Long 等人，2025）同样利用视频级别的批评来优化提示，以用于后续生成轮次。

sents.en: GENMAC ( Huang et al., 2026 ) extends this loop with multi-agent verification and redesign of prompts, layouts, and guidance scales.

sents.en: These approaches differ in whether feedback triggers localized editing or another generation round.
sents.zh: 这些方法的区别在于反馈是触发局部编辑，还是启动新一轮生成。

sents.en: PreCoG obtains feedback from low-cost previews and corrects the cached trajectory before full rendering.
sents.zh: PreCoG 从低成本预览中获取反馈，并在完整渲染前修正缓存的轨迹。

paragraphs.en: Inference-time search improves video generation by exploring multiple candidate noises, latents, or denoising trajectories during sampling. Diffusion latent beam search ( Oshima et al., 2025 ) ranks intermediate latent candidates using a lookahead estimator of their eventual alignment reward. Video-T1 ( Liu et al., 2025 ) explores additional noise candidates with verifier feedback; its Tree-of-Frames strategy adaptively expands and prunes video branches autoregressively to reduce search cost. LatSearch ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) uses latent reward guidance for more efficient trajectory search. CachedSearch ( Saini et al., 2026 ) further reduces the cost of best-of- N N video search by using cached rollouts for exploration. These methods scale quality through wider candidate search, while PreCoG targets the cost of feedback-based correction.
paragraphs.zh: 推理时的搜索通过在采样过程中探索多个候选噪声、潜在变量或去噪轨迹，从而改进视频生成效果。 扩散潜在束搜索（Oshima 等人，2025）利用前瞻估计器对中间潜在变量候选项进行排序，评估其最终的对齐奖励。 Video-T1（Liu 等人，2025）借助验证器反馈探索更多噪声候选项；其“帧树”策略能够自适应地扩展和修剪视频分支，以自回归方式降低搜索成本。 LatSearch（Zhao 等人，2026）利用潜在变量奖励引导，实现更高效的轨迹搜索。 CachedSearch（Saini 等人，2026）通过复用缓存的展开结果进行探索，进一步降低了“N 选最佳”视频搜索的成本。 这些方法通过扩大候选项搜索范围来提升质量，而 PreCoG 则专注于降低基于反馈的修正成本。

paragraphs.en: Flow-based editing studies how to steer generative trajectories between source and target conditions. FlowEdit introduces an inversion-free and optimization-free text-based editing method for pretrained flow models by constructing an ODE that directly maps between source and target prompt distributions ( Kulikov et al., 2024 ) . Recent video extensions and evaluations adapt rectified-flow generators for training-free, inversion-free video editing, including Pyramid-Edit and Wan-Edit in FiVE ( Li et al., 2025b ) . FlowDirector ( Li et al., 2025a ) combines direction-aware flow correction, motion-appearance decoupling, and differential averaging to control appearance, temporal consistency, and editing stability. FlowAnchor ( Chen et al., 2026 ) addresses spatial localization and weakening edit magnitudes through spatial-aware attention refinement and adaptive magnitude modulation. PreEdit reuses source states and velocities cached during generation and accounts for source–condition misalignment inherent to correction. Its target–counterfactual contrast focuses updates on diagnosed failures while attenuating unrelated changes to preserve already correct content.
paragraphs.zh: 基于流的编辑研究如何引导生成轨迹在源条件与目标条件之间转换。 FlowEdit 提出了一种无需反演和优化、基于文本的编辑方法，适用于预训练流模型，其核心是构建一个能够直接在源提示分布与目标提示分布之间映射的常微分方程（Kulikov 等，2024）。 近期的视频扩展与评估研究将修正流生成器应用于无需训练且无需反演的视频编辑，包括 FiVE 中的 Pyramid-Edit 和 Wan-Edit（Li 等，2025b）。 FlowDirector（Li 等，2025a）结合了方向感知的流校正、运动与外观解耦以及微分平均技术，以控制外观表现、时间一致性和编辑稳定性。 FlowAnchor（Chen 等，2026）通过空间感知注意力精修和自适应幅度调制，解决了空间定位问题并减弱了编辑幅度。 PreEdit 重用了生成过程中缓存的源状态与速度，并考虑了校正过程中固有的源条件与目标条件之间的不匹配问题。 其目标-反事实对比机制将更新聚焦于已诊断出的失败部分，同时削弱无关变化，以保留原本正确的内容。

paragraphs.en: Existing approaches to anticipating the outcome of full generation at low cost include preview and lookahead methods that use few-step solvers to produce approximate outputs ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Oshima et al., 2025 ) . Such approximations can inform candidate evaluation. However, these previews do not inherently preserve the native denoising trajectory or its solver state, limiting both computational reuse and subsequent trajectory-based interventions to guide generation. This raises a question: can an informative preview share an initial trajectory segment with full rendering?
paragraphs.zh: 目前用于低成本预测完整生成结果的方法包括预览和前瞻方法，这些方法使用少数步求解器来产生近似输出（Wang 等人，2025；Oshima 等人，2025）。 这类近似结果可以为候选评估提供依据。 然而，这些预览本身并不会保留原始的降噪轨迹或其求解器状态，从而限制了计算资源的重复利用以及后续基于轨迹的干预手段对生成过程的引导。 这引出了一个问题：一个信息丰富的预览能否与完整渲染共享初始的轨迹片段？

paragraphs.en: Given a prompt P 0 P_{0} , PreCoG alternates semantic assessment of low-cost previews with corrective trajectory editing within a fixed budget (Figure ). Because the source trajectory may only partially align with its condition, correction targets unmet requirements while aiming to preserve satisfied ones. PreQA (Section 3.2.1 ) constructs the initial design and forms matched target and counterfactual conditions from preview evidence. PreEdit (Section 3.2.2 ) uses their prediction contrast to modulate source-relative updates through blockwise soft projection. Each correction edits the cached trajectory of the preview with the highest requirement coverage. Only the selected candidate receives full rendering, reusing its edited trajectory segment when available. Algorithm 1 summarizes the framework. The following components detail the three agents, editing, and selection.
paragraphs.zh: 给定提示 P_0，PreCoG 在固定预算内交替对低成本预览进行语义评估，并执行修正性轨迹编辑（图）。 由于源轨迹可能仅与条件部分对齐，因此修正目标会针对未满足的要求进行调整，同时力求保留已满足的要求。 PreQA（第 3.2.1 节）构建初始设计，并根据预览证据形成匹配的目标条件和反事实条件。 PreEdit（第 3.2.2 节）利用预测差异，通过分块软投影来调节相对于源轨迹的更新。 每次修正都会对要求覆盖度最高的预览的缓存轨迹进行编辑。 仅选定的候选项会获得完整渲染；若有可用编辑后的轨迹片段，则会重复使用。 算法 1 总结了该框架。 以下各部分将详细说明三个智能体、编辑机制和选择机制。

Reusing the shared trajectory avoids repeated computation and helps preserve semantic consistency between preview and full video.

paragraphs.en: Assessing full videos increases VBench and VS2 by only 0.07 and 0.007, respectively, while reducing T2V-Comp. by 1.62 points and raising runtime from 2022.9 to 2809.8 seconds. Preview assessment therefore reduces runtime by 28.0% with comparable VBench and VS2 and higher compositional alignment. Removing planning reduces T2V-Comp. from 62.28 to 56.50 and VS2 from 3.854 to 3.644, supporting its role in compositional alignment. Without target refinement, these scores fall further to 53.76 and 3.486, below direct generation. This variant retains diagnosis and failure-condition construction but uses the original prompt as the target. Failure diagnosis must therefore translate into an explicit repair condition.
paragraphs.zh: 评估完整视频仅使 VBench 和 VS2 分别提升 0.07 和 0.007，但 T2V-Comp. 下降了 1.62 分，运行时间则从 2022.9 秒增加至 2809.8 秒。 因此，预览评估将运行时间减少了 28.0%，同时保持了相近的 VBench 和 VS2 分数，并提升了构图一致性。 移除规划步骤后，T2V-Comp. 从 62.28 降至 56.50，VS2 从 3.854 降至 3.644，这支持了规划在构图一致性中的作用。 若没有目标优化，这些分数将进一步下降至 53.76 和 3.486，低于直接生成的结果。 该变体保留了诊断和故障条件构建功能，但使用原始提示作为目标。 因此，故障诊断必须转化为明确的修复条件。

paragraphs.en: We presented PreCoG, a framework for correcting semantic failures during iterative video generation. Low-cost previews support diagnosis without completing every candidate, while cached trajectories provide reusable starting points for correction and final rendering. Experiments show a favorable balance of visual quality, prompt alignment, and inference cost. Qualitative comparisons further illustrate how targeted editing can repair unmet requirements while limiting disruption of already correct content. Gains across multiple feedback models, backbones, and T2V/I2V settings further support the applicability of this approach. This correction process requires no additional training of the video generator. PreCoG makes correction part of the generation process: previews guide targeted edits to cached trajectories, and full rendering is reserved for the selected candidate.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 PreCoG，一个用于在迭代视频生成过程中纠正语义错误的框架。 低成本预览支持在不完成所有候选方案的情况下进行诊断，而缓存的轨迹则为纠正和最终渲染提供了可重用的起点。 实验表明，该方法在视觉质量、提示对齐和推理成本之间实现了良好的平衡。 定性比较进一步说明，通过有针对性的编辑，可以在不破坏已正确内容的前提下修复未满足的需求。 在多种反馈模型、基础架构以及 T2V/I2V 设置中取得的成果，进一步证明了该方法的可适用性。 这一纠正过程无需对视频生成器进行额外训练。 PreCoG 将纠正环节整合到生成过程中：预览引导针对缓存轨迹的编辑，而完整渲染则保留给选定的候选方案。

paragraphs.en: We report a human preference evaluation comparing PreCoG against VQQA, VSR, and GENMAC in blinded pairs. The evaluation includes 96 distinct videos, each assessed by all four raters. paragraphs.en: Figure 6 shows more wins than losses for PreCoG in visual quality and prompt alignment against all three baselines. The largest margins occur against VQQA, with win/loss shares of 46.9%/21.9% for visual quality and 50.0%/21.9% for prompt alignment. PreCoG also outperforms GENMAC in prompt alignment, with 43.8% wins versus 37.5% losses. Against VSR, ties account for 58.0–69.4% of judgments across the three criteria. The paired outputs were therefore often judged comparable, although decisions expressing a preference favored PreCoG in every criterion.

paragraphs.en: We compare PreCoG with direct generation, inference-time search (full best-of- N N and CachedSearch), and agentic generation (VQQA, VSR, and GENMAC). All methods start from the original prompt and use Wan2.2-T2V-A14B with matched resolution and frame count. Methods requiring online scoring or feedback use Qwen3.8-27B. The configurations below describe our Wan2.2 implementations, including their generation budgets and output selection rules.

sents.en: Methods requiring online scoring or feedback use Qwen3.8-27B.
sents.zh: 需要在线评分或反馈的方法使用 Qwen3.8-27B。

sents.en: The configurations below describe our Wan2.2 implementations, including their generation budgets and output selection rules.
sents.zh: 以下配置描述了我们的 Wan2.2 实现，包括其生成预算和输出选择规则。

paragraphs.en: The native backbone generates one full video from the original prompt using the 40 40 -step schedule, without feedback or candidate selection.
paragraphs.zh: 原生主干模型使用 40-40 步调度方案，在原始提示下生成一个完整的视频，过程中不涉及反馈或候选选择。

paragraphs.en: We generate four full videos from the original prompt using a fixed list of distinct seeds. We use the same candidate scoring and selection rule as our CachedSearch implementation: Qwen rates each video against the original prompt on a 0–100 scale, and we deliver the highest-scoring candidate, breaking ties by candidate order.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用一组固定的不同种子，根据原始提示生成四段完整的视频。 我们采用与 CachedSearch 实现相同的候选评分和选择规则：Qwen 在 0–100 的评分尺度上，根据原始提示对每段视频进行评分，然后我们输出得分最高的候选者；若出现同分情况，则按候选者顺序决定。

sents.en: We generate four full videos from the original prompt using a fixed list of distinct seeds.
sents.zh: 我们使用一组固定的不同种子，根据原始提示生成四段完整的视频。

sents.en: We use the same candidate scoring and selection rule as our CachedSearch implementation: Qwen rates each video against the original prompt on a 0–100 scale, and we deliver the highest-scoring candidate, breaking ties by candidate order.
sents.zh: 我们采用与 CachedSearch 实现相同的候选评分和选择规则：Qwen 在 0–100 的评分尺度上，根据原始提示对每段视频进行评分，然后我们输出得分最高的候选者；若出现同分情况，则按候选者顺序决定。

paragraphs.en: Our Wan2.2 adaptation of CachedSearch ( Saini et al., 2026 ) explores eight seeds using cached denoiser computations and the Qwen scoring and selection rule described above. The two search methods share the first four candidate seeds. We use a cache threshold of 0.10 0.10 , with five warmup and five cooldown steps. After selection, the winning seed is regenerated with caching disabled to produce the delivered full video. Its inference cost includes all eight exploration runs, online scoring, and this final regeneration.
paragraphs.zh: 我们基于 Wan2.2 实现的 CachedSearch（Saini 等人，2026）利用缓存的降噪器计算以及上文描述的 Qwen 评分和选择规则，探索了八个种子。 这两种搜索方法共享前四个候选种子。 我们使用的缓存阈值为 0.10 0.10，并设置了五个预热步骤和五个冷却步骤。 选择完成后，会禁用缓存重新生成获胜的种子，以产出最终交付的完整视频。 其推理成本包括全部八次探索运行、在线评分以及这次最终的重新生成。

paragraphs.en: Our VQQA ( Song et al., 2026 ) implementation evaluates each full video with a global score, generates questions about alignment and quality, and uses the answers to refine the prompt before full regeneration. We allow an initial generation and at most four refinements. The loop stops when the global score reaches 100 100 or the best score fails to improve over three refinements. The highest-scoring completed video is delivered, with earlier candidates preferred in ties.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的 VQQA（Song 等人，2026）实现使用全局分数评估每个完整视频，生成关于对齐和质量的提问，并利用答案在完全重新生成前优化提示。 我们允许一次初始生成以及最多四次优化。 当全局分数达到 100 或最佳分数在三次优化后未能提升时，循环将停止。 得分最高的完整视频将被交付，若出现同分情况，则优先选择较早生成的候选版本。

paragraphs.en: We adapt the Visual Self-Refine baseline described in VISTA ( Long et al., 2025 ) to Wan2.2, following the paradigm of iterative feedback and refinement of Self-Refine ( Madaan et al., 2023 ) . Starting from the original prompt, Qwen inspects each video and rewrites the prompt for the next full generation. We use four generations in total, retain seed 17 17 across iterations, and deliver the final video without early stopping or selection of the best candidate.
paragraphs.zh: 我们遵循 Self-Refine（Madaan et al., 2023）的迭代反馈与优化范式，将 VISTA（Long et al., 2025）中描述的 Visual Self-Refine 基线模型适配到 Wan2.2。 从原始提示开始，Qwen 会检查每个视频，并为下一次完整生成重新编写提示。 我们总共使用四代生成，在整个迭代过程中保留种子值 17 17，并直接输出最终视频，不进行提前停止或最佳候选选择。

paragraphs.en: Our Wan2.2 implementation of GENMAC ( Huang et al., 2026 ) retains multi-agent layout planning, verification, and correction, together with object-weighted layout guidance during generation. Guidance uses layers 4 4 , 8 8 , and 12 12 over the first 10 10 denoising steps, with scale 10 10 and one guidance update per step. We allow an initial generation and at most two corrections, using seed 17 17 throughout. The loop stops when verification requests no further revision or the budget is exhausted, and delivers the latest video. The controlled PreQA plus regeneration comparison is specified separately in Section 4.4 .

paragraphs.en: For the initial candidate, cached states at guided steps include initialization guidance. We retain the pre- and post-update states and guidance displacements to replay the source without recomputing layout gradients. paragraphs.en: The six dimensions are subject consistency (SC), background consistency (BC), motion smoothness (MS), aesthetic quality (AQ), imaging quality (IQ), and dynamic degree (DD). paragraphs.en: PreCoG improves all three metrics across the six backbone–task configurations in Table 6 . T2V-Comp. increases by 4.80–7.01 percentage points, while VBench and VS2 increase by 0.65–1.43 percentage points and 0.130–0.190, respectively. For I2V, T2V-Comp. gains of 4.80 and 5.20 percentage points show that correction remains beneficial when generation is conditioned on an input image. These comparisons support the applicability of preview-guided correction across the tested backbones and both conditioning tasks.
paragraphs.zh: PreCoG 在表 6 所示的六种主干网络–任务配置中，均提升了三项指标。 T2V-Comp. 提升了 4.80–7.01 个百分点，而 VBench 和 VS2 分别提升了 0.65–1.43 个百分点和 0.130–0.190。 对于 I2V，T2V-Comp. 获得了 4.80 和 5.20 个百分点的提升，这表明当生成以输入图像为条件时，校正仍然有益。 这些比较支持了预览引导式校正在所有测试主干网络和两种条件任务中的适用性。
